mappings.assertion: TestS1SizeGuard fails if the acceptance_evidence.go file key, the loadDeclaredAcceptanceInput key or the prepareValidationPreflight key is still in area_a5_test.go's ratchet while the code is over the limit, and fails if any remaining key grows. The three keys are removed; the evidence orchestrator and the phased preflight are within the function and file limits, and the phase files (acceptance_declaration.go, acceptance_allocation_review.go, acceptance_reference_reads.go, validation_readiness.go) are each under the file limit.

TestOracleA5Supplement compares json, human and state.yaml captures of SA1-SA10 (uncovered acceptance refusals) and VR1-VR15 (readiness refusals: registration_required, worktree_unavailable, integration_unavailable, configuration_changed, current_session_required, retry_pending, artifact_unsupported, execution_policy_required, session preparation errors, probe failures; the inventory comment in oracle_test.go maps every refusal to its case) against goldens generated from the starting tree by regen write-new (VR1-VR6 and SA1-SA10 before the first production edit, VR7-VR15 on the starting tree 54ef61df3 in a detached worktree, then checked against the refactored tree). pipeline_unavailable is not reachable from a committed fixture and keeps no oracle case; TestSupplementGoldenCoverage and TestSupplementAdapterBoundary pin coverage and the adapter boundary. regen -mode check -pkg ./internal/oracle/a5/... reproduces every golden.

TestValidationReadinessVocabularyKeepsWireSpelling compares every validationCode, result, method and execution-policy constant, the validationFailure text (including artifact_unsupported) and the ErrPreflight identity with independent literals; TestRecordObservationProjectsSanitizedFields and TestSameValidationObservationComparesWhatAnOperatorRepairs pin the record projection and the new-failure comparison. acceptance_declaration_test.go pins readRefusalClass and acceptanceSourceRefusal. Every pre-existing acceptance and preflight white-box test runs unchanged.

TestAcceptanceNamedValuesKeepTheirValues compares each named K7 constant (timeouts, exit sentinel, versions, commit length, poll interval, output and excerpt limits, archive limits, mask, entry name, reason classes, claim-block and remap extra keys, git modes) and the batch timeout with independent literals; the validation vocabulary is pinned by validation_readiness_test.go. Persisted model fields stay strings.
TestOracleA5 compares the delivered A5 goldens, none of which this task changes (git diff of internal/oracle/a5/testdata/golden against the starting commit is empty).
TestS1SizeGuard enforces that area_a5_test.go ratchet keys only shrink: the three removed keys are gone and no key was added or raised.
test target (go test ./...) runs the ops, archguard and A5 oracle suites including the new tests; lint, test-e2e and the race run are mandatory with it.
